{{Top}}
[[File:R2_D2.jpg|thumb|[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] connecting to a dataport.]]
{{Quote|Plug yourself into that wall socket so I can talk with our master again....|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 4">[[Star Wars (1977) 4|''Star Wars'' (1977) 4]]</ref>}}
'''Dataports''' were information ports accessible by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and used to upload or download information. They were usually wall-mounted, but they could be part of a table or desk. One of the components of a dataport was the wall socket, which was the part of a [[computer terminal]] that a [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]] could plug into.

Dataports were built into [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]s; passengers could pay for their ride by inserting a [[credit voucher]] into the dataport once the cab had reached its destination.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
